async function inline(items, op, options, count) {
	await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency: 1, ...options });
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	await mapLimit(items, op, { ...options, concurrency: 1 });
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	await mapLimit(items, Math.min(count, items.length, 1), op);
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	await mapLimit(items, Math.min(count, 1, items.length, 8), op);
	await mapLimit(items, Math.min(count, items.length, 4), op);
}
async function local(items, op) {
	const options = { concurrency: 1 };
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	await mapLimit(items, op, options);
}
async function branch(items, op, fast) {
	const options = { concurrency: 1 };
	if (fast) options.concurrency = 8;
	await mapLimit(items, op, options);
}
async function later(items, op) {
	const options = { concurrency: 1 };
	await mapLimit(items, op, options);
	options.concurrency = 8;
}
async function bracket(items, op) {
	const options = { concurrency: 1 };
	options["concurrency"] = 8;
	await mapLimit(items, op, options);
}
async function shadowed(items, op) {
	const concurrency = 1;
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript-options
	await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency });
}
